title: Janos Papai (Belgrade) to Ferenc Rakoczi II, 6 March 1710: six passages in a graphic-sign alphabet (DECODE R731)

steps.what: Tried to transcribe R731's six graphic-sign passages from the camera images; signs not secure enough for a solve.
Fetched R731 images 4153-4155 and key image R581 (3842) at full resolution.
Checked R581's corner sign line (upside down): a line of cipher signs, not an alphabet; R731 pages carry no decipherment.
Transcribed R731's six graphic-sign passages at 1.8-1.9x zoom into R731_signs.txt (~330 signs, 15 types + dot clusters); tentative.
Validated swap-annealing solver (solve731.py) on Papai's own text enciphered at random, same line lengths: recovered exactly (-8.96/4-gram vs -8.87 real).
Annealed R731 as transcribed, without dots, without swash strokes, reversed: best -10.1/4-gram, no Hungarian.
Benda (ed.) 1963 edition of Papai's Turkish diaries: not online, antiquarian copies only.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from papai1706, which had joined Papai's eleven numeric letters in the envoy key R580/R581 with R731 (6 Mar 1710), whose passages are in a separate graphic-sign alphabet. This profile keeps R731 only.

outcome.method_basis: A control-validated swap-annealing solver with a 4-gram model of Papai's own Hungarian recovers a same-length control exactly but finds no Hungarian on R731 under any reading of the tentative transcription; the sign segmentation and dot patterns cannot be fixed from the camera images.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No sign of R731_signs.txt is claimed as read.
outcome.notes: Attempted, closed unread 21 Sept 2026. Needs better images (the 2448-px camera images do not settle segmentation and dots) or the sign alphabet. Split 14 Oct 2026 from papai1706.

gaps.item: R731 (6 Mar 1710, Belgrade), six graphic-sign passages, ~330 signs
gaps.detail: tentative transcription R731_signs.txt; sign segmentation and dot counts not fixable from 2448-px camera images; validated solver finds no Hungarian; needs better images or the sign alphabet

prior.where: no decipherment on the pages, on DECODE or online; Benda's 1963 edition of Papai's Turkish diaries not checked (not online)
